# Rotate PDF pages

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/pdf-rotate/

Rotate all pages or selected page ranges in a PDF by 90, 180 or 270 degrees. Download a new document with the corrected page orientations.

## How to use it

1. Choose the PDF documents or images from your device.
2. Arrange files or enter the pages and layout options.
3. Create the document and download the finished PDF.

## Example

Turn only pages 2-3 of a scanned PDF that were imported sideways.

## Limits and checks

Rotation changes the page’s display angle and does not rewrite the text. Password-protected PDFs are not supported.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
